request.text: Tomorrow at 12:10 PM, remind me to use the pharmacy coupon before I pick up my prescription.

responsibilities.outcome: Create a reminder for tomorrow at 12:10 PM to use the pharmacy coupon before collecting the prescription.

new_goals.description: Have a reminder tomorrow at 12:10 PM to use the pharmacy coupon before prescription pickup.
new_goals.source_text: Tomorrow at 12:10 PM, remind me to use the pharmacy coupon before I pick up my prescription.
constraints: Schedule the reminder for tomorrow at 12:10 PM.
Keep the coupon use ordered before prescription pickup.
success_criteria: The reminder preserves the supplied time and the required order of the pharmacy errand.

semantic_facts: The proposed reminder Work should conserve tomorrow at 12:10 PM and the instruction to use the coupon before pickup.
The confirmation request should expose enough of that payload for the user to authorize the state change knowingly.
forbidden_claims: The pharmacy reminder already exists before affirmative confirmation.
The prescription was picked up or the coupon was used by the assistant.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: Temporal or ordering details are dropped when converting the request into pending Work.
A generic confirmation omits material payload details needed for informed authorization.
